key_risks: Normal execution risk; service level slips on A-class lines if demand is strong
trigger_for_switch: Switch to the stock lift if A-class availability falls below 93% for two weeks

key_risks: Inventory funding; markdown risk if sales fall short of plan
mitigation_actions: Weekly cash position review; supplier capacity confirmations
trigger_for_switch: Switch if A-class availability stays below 93% for two weeks or Q3 lost-sales rate repeats

key_risks: Volume loss if competitors keep Black Friday discounts; loss of traffic share
mitigation_actions: Targeted promotions on key lines; daily sales tracking in weeks 47-49
trigger_for_switch: Switch back to current plan if weekly sales run 3% below trend in weeks 45-46 or competitors discount over 15%
